penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Diagnosing and fixing Riva/Salesforce/Exchange sync failures requires access to the customer's environment, SOQL query results, Riva logs, and Exchange configuration — inherently per-client manual work.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Debugging enterprise calendar sync issues across three vendors (Riva, Salesforce, Microsoft Exchange) requires live access and iterative troubleshooting — cannot be delivered asynchronously via an automated service.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise sync issues are ongoing — new edge cases arise with every Salesforce or Exchange update, requiring continuous human-in-the-loop support.

rationale: Salesforce admins and RevOps teams at mid-market B2B companies are well-defined buyers with real budget (they already pay for Salesforce + Riva), and broken calendar sync is a high-frequency, high-severity pain. However, the fix requires hands-on access to three vendor environments and iterative debugging — there is no automatable product to build here, only consulting. Even a monitoring/alerting tool would require deep API integrations with Riva's proprietary sync engine, Salesforce Events, and Exchange, far beyond Claude + a simple page. Operational autonomy is near zero and the build complexity is high.
solution_plan: Not recommended for build. The pain is real but the solution space requires either (a) direct API partnerships with Riva (not accessible to a solo operator) or (b) bespoke per-client debugging engagements that are fundamentally consulting work. A solo non-technical operator cannot build or maintain the required technical integrations, and each customer engagement would demand significant manual involvement. This is better suited to a Salesforce consulting firm than an autonomous micro-service factory.
notes: Failed build_gates: operational_autonomy=3 (floor: 7), buildability_with_ai=4 (floor: 6). Problem is real but solution is irreducibly consulting-shaped — no autonomous product path exists.
